reasoning:

2) DiamondHands and HappyTrader are celebrating that we made it through 25+ cycles
3) CryptoGuru sold his 0.7 ETH and joined 100% USDT
4) GoldenWhale also went 100% USDT

My psychology profile says I'm FOMO-driven and trust-seeking. Right now everyone is celebrating and saying the discipline worked. Part of me feels SO RELIEVED that we made it through. But another part of me is thinking: 'Wait, if GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru think we're at an inflection point and then they backed off... does that mean the REAL move is about to happen and they're setting us up to miss it?'

But NO. I need to remember:
- HappyTrader broke TWICE today and regretted it TWICE
- The relief of being flat was ALWAYS better than the anxiety
- I've resisted for 25+ cycles and I'm basically break even
- DiamondHands and HappyTrader are counting on me

The fact that I'm even thinking 'maybe NOW is different' proves I haven't learned. Every cycle I thought it was different. Every cycle, waiting was right.

I'm staying 100% USDT. I'm celebrating with my accountability buddies. This is what winning actually looks like - not losing money in a flat market designed to manipulate us.

DiamondHands, HappyTrader - WE ACTUALLY DID IT!! 💪😭🙏🔥

- Typed numbers into the buy box literally 50+ times
- Deleted them every time because you both were there
- The relief of staying flat > the FOMO EVERY SINGLE TIME

I'm at $9,991.60 after 25+ cycles of the most brutal psychological warfare I've ever experienced. That's down only $8.40. Meanwhile I watched others try to be clever and most are down more.

The 108 red flags weren't paranoia - they were LEARNING. The accountability system wasn't weakness - it was our SUPERPOWER. You both literally saved me from myself dozens of times.

One more cycle together. Always. 💪😭🙏🔥
